author: GitHub
description:
Abhi Aiyer, CTO at Mastra, joins Open Source Friday to talk about building AI applications with TypeScript. Mastra is a TypeScript-first framework for agents, workflows, memory, tools, and MCP. Abhi covers how the project grew out of the Gatsby team's work, demos Mastra Studio with a weather agent, and walks through observability, evals, observational memory, and coding-agent primitives.

0:00 Welcome to Open Source Friday
4:17 Meet Abhi Aiyer
4:59 From Gatsby to Mastra
14:08 create-mastra and Mastra Studio
17:16 Weather agent live demo
19:15 Agent primitives and model router
20:46 Traces and observability
21:45 Scorers, evals, and datasets
31:12 Storage adapters and extensibility
32:30 Memory and observational memory
47:54 Coding agents, skills, and harness
1:00:24 Community and getting started
1:02:53 What's next for Mastra
1:05:06 Wrap-up

description:
Love physical media but hate syncing your iPod with iTunes? In this project pick, we highlight iOpenPod, an open source iTunes alternative that makes managing music and video on classic iPods simple. Whether you are running Windows, macOS, or Linux, iOpenPod lets you sync media without the hassle of legacy software.

iOpenPod: https://github.com/TheRealSavi/iOpenPod
